issues.title: Checkout drops the host name on mobile Safari
issues.body:
The `host_name` field is captured on desktop and lost on iOS.

- reproduced on iOS 18
- serialiser fixed in #213
- regression test still open

The **serialiser** was writing an empty string rather than omitting the key, which the collector then read as a real value. See [the receipt](https://github.com/acme/storefront/pull/215).

issues.title: Rate limiting returns 500 instead of 429
issues.body:
Hammer `/v1/search` and the status code is a 500 with an empty body. It should be a `429` with a `Retry-After`.

The cap itself works: it is named `dailyTurnsPerUser` in the config, which is why nobody found it by grepping for rate limit.
issues.last_word: Two ways to do this and they differ on whether existing clients break. Which one?
